title: FT-0181 no-real-data closeout placeholder with mission/interface still externally blocked
decision_delta_summary: Rev0334 keeps the no-real-data source class and closure block while mapping local teacher/tutor result decisions to bounded follow-through. It does not add owner contact, accepted evidence, custody, public-claim support, cumulative efficacy claims, or FT-0181 closure.
public_summary_actions: Keep public summaries limited to example language and no-real-evidence claim limits.
Do not publish real pilot outcomes or durable learning claims.
Keep policy-exception status and source-status labels visible in any operator-facing handoff.
Do not change public-summary language until a real first-packet decision board names an allowed public-summary effect.
Do not change public-summary language until a real post-decision change ticket names an allowed public-summary effect and a public claim ceiling.
Keep public claim freeze in force through any first live window; usage or satisfaction alone cannot become outcome language.
Do not convert usage, satisfaction, no-incident notes, or rehearsal readouts into learning, safety, access, workload, compliance, or scale claims.
Keep public language frozen until a real end-of-window readout names claim-family effects and public language after readout.
Keep public language frozen until a real post-readout context receipt reroute gate confirms the readout lane and public-language action.
Do not treat a post-readout dispatch as outcome evidence; it only owns the next action after a readout.
evaluator_independence_attestation: No closure review occurred because no real source packet exists; future closure requires at least two reviewers with separated educational and record/security responsibilities.

decision: Do not close FT-0181. Rev0334 contains no accountable owner contact, route block, owner-reviewed SRC2+ packet, accepted evidence, custody, closeout, signoff, real teacher/tutor field cycle, owner-reviewed legitimate result, or evidence-supported result-decision escalation.
